hook: This Mayan Cleanse Supports A Healthy Weight And Gut
claim: Cleanest Body is a liquid 'Mayan cleanse' added daily to juice, tea or water, sold for weight loss and gut health.
story: Its ingredient list is identical to GlucoFlush, which the same style of page sells for blood sugar: a herbal parasite-cleanse blend of fennel, marshmallow root, pumpkin seed, slippery elm, clove, garlic, oregano oil, peppermint oil and papaya seed.
use: One dropper a day added to orange juice, tea or water. The seller advises taking it two hours apart from medication.
price_note: Cleanest Body is sold as 2, 3 or 6 bottles with free shipping; totals appear on the order page.
checks: None of the ingredients has evidence for weight loss.
Parasites aren't a common cause of weight gain in developed countries.
The same formula is sold for blood sugar under another name.
Separating it from medicines by two hours is sensible, because mucilage herbs can slow drug absorption.
cons: Parasite cleanse sold for weight loss
Identical to a product sold for blood sugar
verdict: Cleanest Body is a rebadged herbal cleanse. It won't cause weight loss. Sustainable weight loss comes from changes to diet, activity and sleep, and for some people from medical treatment.
